# CTV News Montreal

> > CTV News Montreal delivers comprehensive local news coverage, weather updates, traffic reports, and breaking news for Montreal, Quebec, and surrounding communities.

CTV News Montreal is the regional division of CTV News, Canada's most-watched national news network, providing in-depth coverage of Montreal and Quebec provincial news, including crime, politics, sports, and community events affecting residents across the Greater Montreal area.

## Key Topics

- Montreal local news
- Quebec provincial news
- Breaking news coverage
- Crime and public safety
- Weather and traffic updates
- Montreal politics
- Quebec sports coverage
- Repentigny
- Laurent Dubreuil
- Maisonneuve-Rosemont Hospital
- Canadian national news
- Community events
- Regional investigations

## Main News Hub

- [Montreal: Local News, Weather & Traffic Updates](https://montreal.ctvnews.ca/): Montreal and Quebec local news, weather, crime, politics and sports coverage
